Name: Fancy Marble Fireplace
Author: coldazrael
Description:
This mod is made for [url=https://www.discord.gg/stardewvalley]stardew valley discord[/url] winter 2020 Event. (further descriptions will be added soon because I don't have lots of time atm lol)

[b]Installation :[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install Content Patcher if you haven't installed it yet.
[*]Download the Mod,
[*]Drop the Mod folder ( [font=Courier New][CP] Fancy Marble Fireplace[/font] ) to Mods folder.

[/list][b]Config Options :[/b]
Start by opening the config.json file with text editor (I personally recommend Notepad++).[list]
[*][i]FireplaceToggle[/i]
﻿Master for the fireplace you wanted to replace the model with this new one, the values are "brick", "stone", "iridium", "stove", "monster", and "elegant". The default is "elegant".[/list]
